name: Diadem of Songs

passives.name: Harmony
passives.effects: Grants heal and shield power equal to 0.5% bonus mana.

passives.name: Consonance
passives.effects: Heal the most wounded allied champion you have healed or shielded in the last 3 seconds who is in combat with champions within 900 units for 0.8% of your maximum mana (1 second cooldown).

description:
200 Health
8% Heal and Shield Power
1000 Mana
100% Base Mana Regen

Harmony
Gain % Heal and Shield Power.

Consonance
While you or any ally you've healed or shielded in the last 3 seconds is in combat with champions, each second, heal the lowest health nearby ally champion.
